description.value:
An ancient elven cloak recovered from the sarcophagus of a long-dead warden of Lonelywood's forest. The fabric is pale grey-green, woven from materials that no longer exist, threaded with silver runes that pulse faintly in moonlight. It is cold to the touch — always.

The warden who wore this was the last of her order. She did not die defending her grove. She died waiting for someone worthy to continue the work.

Properties

Death Ward (1/day). The first time you drop to 0 hit points while wearing this cloak, you instead drop to 1 hit point. The silver runes go dark and cold until the next dawn.

Speak with Animals (3/day). You can cast speak with animals without expending a spell slot.

Pass Without Trace (1/day). You can cast pass without trace without expending a spell slot. When cast this way, the spell requires no concentration and lasts 1 hour.

"Protect it." — the only word heard by anyone who attunes to this cloak, whispered in old Elvish.
